Applicability qualifier confirmed by fetching https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2024-8096.html on 2026-09-08: "This issue only exists when curl is built to use the GnuTLS library" and "The vulnerable code can only be reached when curl is built to use GnuTLS." This is not a structured field in the feed; requires.tls_backend was set from that advisory prose. Homebrew core curl depends on openssl@3, never GnuTLS, so a core-tap install resolves to no-known-match for this record.
